statement: This sketch creates an infinite, dynamic weaving pattern that fills the entire canvas with interlocking geometric threads. The visualization uses a 3D webGL renderer to create an immersive, crystalline lattice structure where threads move in synchronized wave motions. The color palette shifts through hues based on position and time, creating a constantly evolving visual texture. Each thread follows a path defined by sine and cosine functions, creating the illusion of physical fabric being woven. The pattern is composed of multiple layers: individual threads crossing each other in complex patterns, and a central rotating lattice structure that adds depth and dimension to the overall composition. The motion appears fluid yet structured, resembling both organic weaving and geometric crystal formation, with no user input required for the continuous animation.
